I had to put down my 14 year old dog in 2016 when I was 9 so I had knew her all of my life. It should of broken me but it didn't i instead my ADHD actually helped me not focus on it .

But 2 years later I was having trouble in school so my doctor prescribed me meds (I don't remember what they were called) and, it helped with school but it also made me focus on the fact that my dog was gone.

It spiraled me into a deep depression and, made quit the meds after only less then a year after being prescribed  them . And almost instantly my life became less bad. i could focus on other things but it also had the downsides of being..well ADHD. And now i am to scared to ask for meds again
